subject: Deal momentum: MAP safety net & procurement gating
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP & procurement gating — timeline concern

Hi Hannah,

Quick note from procurement: they flagged our timeline during their intake — the required vendor evidence (SOC 2 summary and retention policy) needs review before they greenlight any PO. That review typically adds 10-12 business days on the Acme side.

We're still aligned with the functional eval dates, but procurement gating creates a real risk to the close date if we keep the current MAP as-is. Can Redwood provide a short MAP variant that (a) protects our momentum and (b) gives procurement the artifacts they need without stalling the technical eval?

Attached: Procurement_Timeline.pdf (procurement's internal gate checklist)

—Sarah
Sarah Li
Senior Procurements Manager, Acme Corp

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acme.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & procurement gating — timeline concern

Sara(h),

Thanks for the heads up — I appreciate the clarity. I put together a slimmed-down MAP that keeps the eval runway intact while front-loading the security artifacts procurement needs. The short version:

- Move legal/PO milestone by 14 business days (soft rebaseline) to create a procurement safety window.
- Keep feature eval, canary, and performance validation unchanged — those run in parallel to procurement review.
- Redwood will deliver a SOC2 excerpt and a retention summary within 48 hours to fast-track their checklist.
- Offer a temporary trial extension and a one-time credit if procurement delays the PO beyond the safety window.

I'll attach Proposed_MAP_v2.xlsx with the dates shaded. If that looks good to Acme, can we get a 30-minute sync today to lock the updates?

Attachments: Proposed_MAP_v2.xlsx (proposed MAP with safety-window)

Best,

4) Escalation triggers: Procurement delay > 20 business days -> escalate to Hannah (AE) -> Laura (AM) -> Sales Ops + CS for temporary staging option.
5) Action items:

   - Stephanie Nguyen: one-page data-flow slide (due 2026-12-01 17:00 PST)
   - Laura Bennett: confirm credit approval path and maximum value (due 2026-12-02)
